normaPage.title: Who {name} was
normaPage.seoDescription: Who Norma Edith Bedoya was, what she did in Riacho He Hé, and what she left done. The story of a person, not of a cause.
normaPage.contribution: If you knew her and want something of that to appear in her story, the family will listen. There is no published address for that yet; when there is, it will be here and on the
normaPage.radioReserved: A photo of Norma at the radio in Riacho He Hé will go here.
normaPage.photosNote: Norma's photos were chosen by her family. The one from the radio is still missing, and that space stays empty until it arrives: we will not put a stock image in the place of a photo of her.

whatHappenedPage.seoDescription: On 7 September, at 4.30 in the morning, a fire destroyed the family home in Riacho He Hé. Norma died. This is the story, the photos, and what is needed now.
whatHappenedPage.lostValue: Most of the house and everything that was inside
whatHappenedPage.seeBefore: If you want to see first where the money will go, it is all in

reconstructionPage.seoDescription: What has to be rebuilt in the house, the budget by line with quoted amounts, the work milestones and the published progress.
reconstructionPage.noMilestonesTitle: No milestones have been published yet
reconstructionPage.noMilestonesBody: Milestones are loaded when the work has a plan with stages. Until then there is no timeline to show, and an empty one would say nothing.
reconstructionPage.photosNote: Photos of the progress are published with each update, so each one is dated and can be shared on its own.
reconstructionPage.seeNews: See the updates from the site
reconstructionPage.helpLead: Each gift is recorded and each expense is published. You can see both numbers on the same page.

helpPage.seoDescription: Details to transfer from Argentina, Chile or the United States. This page does not take money or ask for card details: gifts go by bank transfer.
helpPage.beforeTransfer: Check that you are on the right domain. If the bank details you see do not match the ones we share on our channels, do not transfer. We will never ask you for a password, a code from your bank, or your card details.
helpPage.accountsHeading: Choose where you will transfer from
helpPage.afterLinkLead: Everything that comes in and everything that goes out is in
helpPage.afterLinkTail: , with the date of the last reconciliation in view.
helpPage.shareLead: If you cannot give, sharing the link still helps. Most of the people who got this far did so because someone passed it on.

transparencyPage.helpLeadTail: tell each step as it happens.

legacyPage.seoDescription: What Fundación Norma proposes once the house is finished, where the project stands today, and what Riacho Conecta is.
legacyPage.statusBody: Fundación Norma is an intention, not an entity. It has no legal personality, no statute, no tax ID, and no account of its own. Today's gifts go to rebuilding the house and are accounted for on
legacyPage.statusTail: . When the foundation actually exists, this page will say so with the papers in view.
legacyPage.radioReserved: A photo of Norma at the radio will go here, the one that explains where all of this comes from.
legacyPage.houseFirstLead: None of this starts before the family has a place to live. That is the work now.

riachoPage.seoDescription: Free training in digital tools in Riacho He Hé: the topics proposed and where the programme stands.
riachoPage.noSignup: There are no dates or places, so there is nothing to sign up for. When the programme has a calendar it will be published in
riachoPage.noSignupTail: and on this same page. We are not asking for your email to tell you later: we would rather not keep people's details for something that does not exist yet.
riachoPage.whereLead: {locality} is a town in the Pilcomayo department, in {province}, {country}. The programme is meant to teach there, not to invite people to leave.
riachoPage.legacyLink: How it fits into Fundación Norma
